data.rationale: The proposal gets the search steps right (Sail To, Sail From, Dates, SEARCH CRUISES) with matching parameters, but it leaves out the final step of clicking the favorite heart on a result and adds a guest-count step that the true occurrence doesn't have. The steps are concrete enough to automate, but the workflow would stop at search results without favoriting anything.
